label: Flash in the browser
before: The plug-in could run the site's Flash content.
after: Adobe blocked Flash content from running in Flash Player on January 12, 2021.

label: Office macros from the internet
before: A familiar warning offered an Enable Content button for macros in an untrusted file.
after: Affected Office apps on Windows block these macros by default. Trust settings and managed exceptions still matter.

label: Mail for strangers
before: An open mail relay would forward mail between outsiders, a useful courtesy that spammers could abuse.
after: Sendmail 8.9 refused third-party relaying by default. Administrators could still authorize their own users and networks.

label: Opening an HTTP site
before: Chrome could label the connection insecure while still opening the page.
after: Chrome's default warning now asks before connecting to public HTTP sites. Chrome remembers recent approvals and generally skips the warning for local addresses and intranets.
beforeAction: Page opens with a warning label
